overview: Dead Air is a first-person flashlight-and-pistol survival horror game set in the Hollow Pine relay station. During a midnight-to-dawn shift, you maintain the generator and send five scheduled all-clear broadcasts while a sound-hunting presence stalks the building. Five station-log pages reveal the previous operator’s experience through the journal.
rules: Keep the generator fuelled and send all five scheduled broadcasts during the 00:00–06:00 shift.
The Caller is blind and tracks sound. Sneaking is quiet; running and gunfire attract danger.
Flashlight and pistol hits stagger the Caller briefly instead of permanently defeating it.
Battery and ammunition are scarce; station logs can be reread in the Journal.
controls: WASD moves; mouse looks; Shift sneaks.
T toggles the flashlight; left mouse fires; E interacts.
J opens the journal; F5/F9 save/load; F fullscreen; Escape menu.
story: You are keeping Hollow Pine’s relay broadcasting until dawn. Scattered station logs tell the prior operator’s story as something outside answers the transmissions.
